notes:
- Automatic updates: Wayfolder checks for a new version and installs it with one click (Settings › Updates)
- Presentation preview (PPTX): slide viewer with a list of mini slides; Word and spreadsheet previews
- Your own folders in Quick access (add, remove, reorder)
- Pinned tabs; tabs can be dragged between windows and out into a new window
- New window frame: tabs act as the title bar
- Faster, more reliable thumbnails
